definitions.explanation: The original version of a creative work, especially a novel, manga, or other literary work that has been adapted into another medium such as film, anime, or drama.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原作|げんさく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The original work this movie is based on is a novel.

examples.japanese: {原作|げんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched the anime after reading the original work.

examples.japanese: {原作|げんさく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ストーリー→ストーリー：11018_sutoorii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結末|けつまつ}→結末：15091_ketsumatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なっている→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The ending of the story differs significantly between the original work and the TV drama.

notes:
Extremely common in discussions of adaptations — comparing manga to anime, novels to films, etc. {原作|げんさく}{者|しゃ} refers to the author of the original work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原作|げんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ — to read the original work
- {原作|げんさく}{者|しゃ} — the original author
- {原作|げんさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忠実|ちゅうじつ}→忠実：12570_chuujitsu⟧ — faithful to the original
- {原作|げんさく}{通|どお}り — as in the original
- {原作|げんさく}⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧ — fans of the original work
